adaptations.name: Vengeance UI Spotlight Navbar
adaptations.modifications: Historical native interaction study. Current mission-interactions.js retains optional presentation effects; components.css and home.css provide the current static navigation and link treatment. The earlier pointer-following navigation spotlight is retired.

adaptations.name: Skiper UI Skiper40 CssLink
adaptations.attribution: Visible homepage footer and interface source records
adaptations.modifications: Retired link-transition study. Current navigation changes text color, footer links use ordinary text-decoration, and the launch arrow changes color. No Skiper Link000/Link001 transform-origin/scale underline or SVG arrow implementation remains in the distributed interface. Historical source, authorship and custom terms remain recorded; those terms are not relabeled as OSI or Apache-2.0.

adaptations.name: Vengeance UI Kinetic Text Loader
adaptations.modifications: Native DOM/CSS adaptation of the 1800ms moving dot, L bounce and i stretch. Local Inter font, responsive em units, accessible original status text, automatic dynamic status decoration and reduced-motion fallback; no React, Tailwind or remote fonts.
